meta.description: Study programmes per institution and fine-grained discipline (see disciplines.json). PILOT: 10 institutions.
meta.verified_note: Every record has verified: false. Programme names and URLs were read from the institutions' own websites (programme lists and programme pages) but have not been checked by a person.
rules: Only what the institution's official pages state is recorded; nothing is inferred from other institutions or from general knowledge.

levels: BA, MA, Doc. At Conservatoire de Paris the 1st/2nd/3rd cycles are mapped to BA/MA/Doc; BEd/MEd count as BA/MA. An empty levels list means the page names the study but not a BA/MA/Doc level (see the evidence note).
Doctoral study is recorded as level Doc on a discipline only where the institution names that field on its doctoral page.
Absence of a record means 'not found on the pages that were read', not 'not offered'.

verification_log.method: Full site crawl: fetched the paginated study-programmes listing (3 pages, 89 programme pages found vs. ~30 from the earlier summarised pass), then fetched and parsed every programme page's raw HTML directly (no LLM summarisation).
corrections_by_user: Cultural Study of Music: added MA and Doc (no dedicated page found; from the user's institutional knowledge)
chamber-music: recorded as its own discipline, evidenced from the Strings programme page (no dedicated chamber-music page exists)

verification_log.method: Full raw-HTML crawl of each institution's own programme/department listing (curl, no LLM summarisation), following pagination and nested listing pages where the site had them (this is what the first pass missed: koncon.nl's filtered listings, nmh.no's real /en/departments listing, mdw.ac.at's full 239-item list, moz.ac.at's course finder including nested instrumental-pedagogy paths). ESMUC, UNMB and KMH listings were already complete in the first pass and were re-confirmed by raw crawl with no pagination found.
